headword: {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}

definitions.gloss: non-regular employment; irregular employment; contingent work
definitions.explanation: Employment that is not full-time permanent ({正社員|せいしゃいん}). Includes part-time work, contract work, temporary staffing, and other non-standard arrangements.

examples.japanese: {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The proportion of non-regular employment is increasing.

examples.japanese: {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧や⟦{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In non-regular employment, there are differences in wages and benefits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: The government is working on improving conditions for non-regular workers.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-) + ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧ (regular, standard) + ⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧ (employment). A major social issue in modern Japan, where non-regular workers make up a significant portion of the workforce.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}: non-regular workers
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧: increase in non-regular employment
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: from non-regular to regular employment
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: the non-regular employment problem

TYPES OF NON-REGULAR WORK:
- ⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧: part-time work
- ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧: part-time/casual work
- ⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧: temporary staffing/dispatch work
- ⟦{契約社員|けいやくしゃいん}→契約社員：12260_keiyakushain⟧: contract employee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正規雇用|せいきこよう}: regular employment — full-time permanent positions with full benefits and job security
